title: Bounded-height Dyck language

problem.name: Bounded-height Dyck language
problem.statement_latex: Given $x\in\{(,)\}^n$ and height bound $h$, decide whether every prefix has balance in $[0,h]$ and the final balance is zero. Complexity counts queries to parenthesis symbols.
problem.statement_text: Given $x\in\{(,)\}^n$ and height bound $h$, decide whether every prefix has balance in $[0,h]$ and the final balance is zero. Complexity counts queries to parenthesis symbols.

quantum.headline_latex: $O(\min\{n,\sqrt n\log^{h/2}n\})$ queries by Khadiev--Shen's recursive minimal-unbalanced-substring search.
